headlines.text: Rewind to 2026, when Callum Newman vs. Francesco Akira vs. HENARE vs. Will Ospreay vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Daniel Garcia vs. Jon Moxley vs. PAC settled things in a Chaos In Canada match, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 8.04 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. In a "Chaos in Canada" Anything Goes brawl, Will Ospreay's United Empire ? himself, Callum Newman, HENARE and Francisco Akira ? overran Moxley's Death Riders trio of Castagnoli, PAC and Garcia.

Flash back to 2022, when Jon Moxley vs. Wheeler Yuta closed out Rampage, rated 9.12 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype in a hard-fought men's division clash. A star-making performance from Yuta ? bloodied and battered, he kicked out of two Paradigm Shifts and earned real respect from William Regal afterward, a defeat that ultimately launched him into the Blackpool Combat Club.
It was 2020 when Michael Nakazawa stepped through the curtain for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.75.

secondaries.text: That Wednesday in 2020, Cody vs. Shawn Spears met in a Tournament Match, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 6.47.
That Wednesday in 2026, Andrade, Davis & Takeshita made their first appearance under the AEW banner as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.16 ? a solid showing.
Turning the clock back to 2022: it was Willow Nightingale's first night in AEW against Red Velvet, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.14.
